# MacroTrackr

> A free, open source macro and calorie tracker. Log meals in seconds, set a
> macro split, and review the week. Self-hostable under AGPLv3, with a hosted
> option at $3.99/month for cross-device sync.

MacroTrackr is a progressive web app, not an App Store listing. Core tracking
and all calculators are free. Barcode scanning uses the OpenFoodFacts database
and is free with no premium tier. There are no banner ads and no third-party ad
trackers.

The site renders client-side, so pages fetched without JavaScript return a
reduced fallback. The summaries below carry the substance of each page.

## Calculators

- [TDEE Calculator](https://macrotrackr.com/tools/tdee-calculator): Total Daily
  Energy Expenditure from bodyweight, height, age, sex and activity level.
  Derives BMR via Mifflin-St Jeor, then applies an activity multiplier.
- [BMR Calculator](https://macrotrackr.com/tools/bmr-calculator): Basal
  Metabolic Rate using the Mifflin-St Jeor equation.
- [Macro Calculator](https://macrotrackr.com/tools/macro-calculator): converts a
  calorie target into daily grams of protein, carbohydrate and fat, with
  adjustable percentage splits.
- [Weight Loss Calculator](https://macrotrackr.com/tools/weight-loss-calculator):
  daily deficit, weekly rate and projected goal date. Flags targets below
  1,200 kcal (female) or 1,500 kcal (male).
- [Protein Calculator](https://macrotrackr.com/tools/protein-calculator): daily
  protein in grams from 1.2 to 2.4 g/kg depending on training context, plus a
  per-meal figure.

## Comparisons

Competitors change their pricing, so the figures live on the comparison pages
rather than here, where they would be quoted long after they stopped being true.

- [vs MyFitnessPal](https://macrotrackr.com/compare/myfitnesspal): barcode
  scanning and custom macro goals sit behind MyFitnessPal's paid tier. Both are
  free on MacroTrackr.
- [vs MacroFactor](https://macrotrackr.com/compare/macrofactor): MacroFactor has
  no free tier beyond a trial. MacroTrackr's free tier does not expire.
- [vs Cronometer](https://macrotrackr.com/compare/cronometer): MacroTrackr
  targets calories and macros rather than an extensive micronutrient table.
- [vs Lose It!](https://macrotrackr.com/compare/lose-it): custom macro gram
  targets are free on MacroTrackr.

## Switching from another tracker

CSV import with a preview before anything is written:
[MyFitnessPal](https://macrotrackr.com/migrate/myfitnesspal),
[Cronometer](https://macrotrackr.com/migrate/cronometer),
[MacroFactor](https://macrotrackr.com/migrate/macrofactor),
[Lose It!](https://macrotrackr.com/migrate/lose-it).

## Notes

Calculator output is an estimate for general fitness planning, not medical
advice. Anyone with a medical condition affecting diet should speak to a
qualified professional.
